description:
7 places on Earth that look completely FAKE — a mirror the size of a country, a bubblegum-pink lake, crystals as long as a bus. All real.

I grouped them into three zones — alien land, fire and heat, and impossible water and sky — and honestly? I had to read some of these facts twice. Socotra's alien trees, rocks that walk across Death Valley, a cave in Mexico that can cook you in minutes... and my winner at the end genuinely broke my brain. Which one looks the most fake to YOU?
